bearer.description: IAM access token (aud mailos or the console client).

info.description: Transactional email for IAM and the MailOS console. Every /api/v1 operation needs an IAM access token (Bearer, or DPoP for sender-constrained tokens). Console users need a MailOS role (mailos_admin, mailos_template_editor, mailos_template_publisher, mailos_operator, mailos_auditor, mailos_viewer); sensitive operations need a sign-in no older than 5 minutes with a second factor and answer 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED with an RFC 9470 WWW-Authenticate challenge otherwise.
info.title: MailOS API

get.description: The tenant's audit events in IAM's format, newest first. Each read is audited (audit_log.viewed). Permission: `audit:read`.

Up to 10,000 events; audited as audit_log.exported. Permission: `audit:export`. Needs step-up (a sign-in with a second factor within 5 minutes); otherwise 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED with an RFC 9470 WWW-Authenticate challenge.

post.description: For service clients only (IAM client-credentials token with aud mailos). Body is IAM's event envelope {id, type, source, data, tenant_uuid, organization_uuid}. The client must be allow-listed for the topic (MAILOS_SERVICE_CLIENTS) and may act only for its tenant; refusals are 403 and audited as event.refused. 202 {accepted, delivery_id, event_id, duplicate}; a repeated id is a duplicate with no second message. Permission: `events:dispatch`.

get.description: Per purpose (provider, dkim, webhook): keys, state and how many values each seals. Never key material. Permission: `settings:manage`. Needs step-up (a sign-in with a second factor within 5 minutes); otherwise 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED with an RFC 9470 WWW-Authenticate challenge.

post.description: Retires the active key; the schedule re-encrypts what it sealed and then destroys it. Permission: `settings:manage`. Needs step-up (a sign-in with a second factor within 5 minutes); otherwise 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED with an RFC 9470 WWW-Authenticate challenge.

get.description: The token's subject, tenant, MailOS roles and the permissions they grant. Permission: `templates:read`.
The caller's own tenant only; tenants come from IAM and are provisioned on first use. Permission: `settings:read`.
The caller's own tenant; any other id is 404. Permission: `settings:read`.
Static catalogue built from IAM's events; secret variables are masked in previews and message views. Permission: `templates:read`.
?locale= (defaults to default_locale); 404 when none is published. Permission: `templates:read`.
?locale=en|ur. Revision 0 when none is saved, seeded from the active version. Permission: `templates:read`.

put.description: 409 CONFLICT when revision is stale; 422 VALIDATION with details; unknown variables come back as meta.warnings. Raw HTML design nodes only for mailos_admin with FEATURE_RAW_HTML_BLOCKS. Permission: `templates:edit`.

post.description: Renders unsaved content with data; variables HTML-escaped by context. Rate limited per user. Permission: `templates:edit`.

Body {locale, revision}. Creates an immutable version, active for its locale only. 403 FOUR_EYES_REQUIRED when the tenant requires four-eyes and the publisher last edited the draft. Permission: `templates:publish`. Needs step-up (403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED with an RFC 9470 challenge).
Renders the saved draft, subject prefixed [Test], from a verified sending domain. Audited; rate limited per user. Permission: `templates:edit`.

get.description: Four-eyes publishing and message retention. Permission: `settings:read`.

put.description: Audited with before and after. Permission: `settings:manage`. Needs step-up (a sign-in with a second factor within 5 minutes); otherwise 403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED with an RFC 9470 WWW-Authenticate challenge.
